# Skill Verdict | Don't chase, attract!

Backed by anonymous, peer-validated reviews and real-world skill assessments, CV2.0 proves your true engineering ability and delivers actionable feedback to help you grow—while giving companies instant, trusted access to verified talent they can rely on.

## Key Features

### [Skill Verdict](https://skillverdict.com/): 
A platform that provides a comprehensive evaluation of engineering skills through peer reviews and assessments, ensuring that both candidates and companies can trust the results.

### [CV2.0](https://skillverdict.com/#cv-preview): 
The latest version of the Skill Verdict system, designed to enhance the assessment process and provide more accurate feedback on engineering capabilities.

## User Guidance

### [How it works](https://skillverdict.com/#process): 
An overview of the processes involved in the Skill Verdict system, detailing how assessments are conducted and how feedback is generated for users.

### [FAQs](https://skillverdict.com/#faq): 
A collection of frequently asked questions that address common inquiries about the Skill Verdict platform, its functionality, and user experience.

### [Contact Us](https://skillverdict.com/contact): 
Information on how to reach the Skill Verdict team for support or inquiries, including email contact at [contact@skillverdict.com](mailto:contact@skillverdict.com).

## Company Information

### [Benefits](https://skillverdict.com/#benefits): 
A detailed explanation of the advantages of using Skill Verdict for both candidates seeking to validate their skills and companies looking to hire verified talent.

### [Companies](https://skillverdict.com/#company-discovery): 
Information about the types of companies that utilize Skill Verdict to find and assess engineering talent, highlighting the platform's industry relevance.
